name: kyte
description: Kyte options market on Robinhood Chain for your AI agent: live markets, offers, prices, positions, staking, fee proof and Pons launchpad graduations, plus prepared trades you review and sign in your own wallet. Read-only server: no keys, no transactions.

interface.shortDescription: Options market data and prepared trades on Robinhood Chain.
interface.longDescription: Kyte connects your agent to a non-custodial, fully collateralised options market on Robinhood Chain. Ask for open calls and puts, prices, charts, your positions, staking and the on-chain fee proof, or have it prepare a trade: it returns a kyte.sh link you review and sign in your own wallet. The server never holds keys and never sends a transaction.
defaultPrompt: What PONS calls are open on Kyte right now?
Which Pons tokens graduated today and are listed on Kyte?
Prepare a covered call on 10 PONS, 20% above spot, 1 day.
